list.name: value
list.definition: the returned value (dicts in insertion order, tuples as lists)

list.name: error_class
list.definition: Python exception class name; Rust reports the mapped class name

list.name: error_message
list.definition: str(exception) character for character for the message classes listed; class only otherwise

tolerance_classes.EXACT_VALUE: strings, ints, booleans, None, statuses, dict key order, list lengths and the int-vs-float type of every value equal; error class equal; messages equal for the registered message classes
tolerance_classes.ULP_BOUNDED: every float: |rust - py| <= 4 ulp(py) or <= 1e-12 * max(1, |py|); NaN matches NaN, +-inf exact

exact_invariants.statement: determinism: the Rust call list evaluated in two separate processes gives byte-identical output

every returned record carries quantity_type 'model-derived' and, on the two wall fields, wall_flux_provenance with trustworthy and wall_life_trustworthy True (both)

mapping.ValueError: ValueError (refusal: NOT_EVALUATED for not-admitted / not wall_life_trustworthy, MODEL_ERROR otherwise); message scored

documented_divergence.statement: none (Python call-signature TypeErrors for missing keyword arguments have no Rust analogue and are not registered calls)

domain_and_error_parity.mapping_rule: every Python exception class maps to exactly one Rust class name; no Rust path may return a value where Python fails, or fail where Python returns, except the registered divergences (CLAUDE.md rule 3)

rules: record keys value, unit, source, evidence_level, quantity_type, uncertainty, applicability_domain, validation_status (+ wall_flux_provenance) in that order
map_meta_sha256 = sha256 of json.dumps(map_meta, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'))

golden_and_reference_cases.rule: references are read as committed; they are never regenerated to make Rust pass (RM-R11)

captured_reference_outputs.purpose: lets CI check Rust against the Python reference after Python is retired from active execution

golden_and_reference_cases.historical_golden_rule: RM-R28: no golden_v1 / golden_v2 case is used

performance_measurement.status: reported, not a decision criterion (A9.24 items 1 and 6)
performance_measurement.statistic: median wall-clock per implementation in one session on one machine; speed-up = median_python / median_rust (Rust timed inside life_eval)

decision_rules.per_test: every scored observable of every call meets its tolerance class
decision_rules.verdict: ADMITTED (= PARITY_PASS) iff every call of every vector, every invariant, every conservation check and every registered divergence outcome passes and every reference file matches sha256_at_registration; otherwise NOT_ADMITTED (PARITY_FAIL)
decision_rules.no_retuning: tolerances, observables, inputs, n, seeds and rules are fixed; after NOT_ADMITTED only a code fix plus a new contract version with a fresh scoring_master_seed may follow; the failed report stays
decision_rules.disagreement_rule: never rewrite a Python result, golden, evidence record or frozen dataset to make Rust pass (RM-R11)
decision_rules.observable_scope: restricted to the retained selected-architecture functions listed (RM-R20)
decision_rules.meaning_of_ADMITTED: A9.24 item 1: Rust (abep_subsystems::life::hall_wall) becomes authoritative for the Hall-map wall-flux gate within the registered domain; with the credible set EMPTY it refuses every member (NOT_EVALUATED)

bid_boundary.statement: post-bid-freeze work; no output of this contract may be cited by the bid package unless the owner re-freezes

what_this_is_not: not physics evidence or validation: parity shows the Rust code reproduces the Python reference, not that either is right
not a change of any frozen dataset, golden, evidence record, threshold or requirement
not authority before admission: until ADMITTED the Python reference is authoritative
not a promotion of any provisional input (RM-R27): literature-class priors stay priors

not a gate PASS and not a life verdict: absent determining evidence stays NOT_EVALUATED / INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE / OUT_OF_DOMAIN / MODEL_ERROR (RM-R31); no 15,000 h / 26,280 h comparison is made in raw physics (SC-WP-11)
